# plan/client

## Variables

### default

```ts
default: Readonly<{
  protocol: "shiitake.client/v1";
  id: string & Brand<"ExtensionId">;
  promptPresentation?: "footer";
  attach?: (context) => Effect<void, Error, Scope>;
  contribute?: (slot) => object;
```

Only an open plan occupies the footer, where it is inspectable and clearable; a
finished or cleared plan hides while its committed history stays in state.
